subject.title: fix: Kubernetes teardown preserves custom namespaces

question: Should `./scripts/k8s/deploy.sh --delete` permanently retain the namespace for all values of `OPENCLAW_NAMESPACE`, including the default `openclaw` namespace?
rationale: Current documentation promises deletion of the namespace, while the reported data-loss scenario establishes that the script cannot safely infer namespace ownership; choosing the enduring public teardown contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt safe namespace retention
options.body: Keep this PR’s namespaced-resource teardown as the new default and reserve full namespace removal for a future explicitly destructive command if needed.

options.title: Preserve default cleanup semantics
options.body: Retain deletion only for a deliberately owned namespace through an explicit, documented ownership policy or a separately named destructive mode.

recommendation.title: Adopt safe namespace retention
recommendation.body: Keep this PR’s namespaced-resource teardown as the new default and reserve full namespace removal for a future explicitly destructive command if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public Kubernetes lifecycle and compatibility decision rather than a narrowly mechanical script repair.
